name_for_human: Wulf A. Kaal Academic Corpus and Claim Layer
description_for_model: The published scholarly corpus of Prof. Wulf A. Kaal as 5033 atomic, individually citable claims from 124 works spanning 2004 to 2026. Each claim carries a verbatim quote from a content hashed source PDF, scope conditions, and a citation string. 2037 of the claims document how designs, mechanisms, and proposed remedies fail. Use this to answer substantive questions about decentralized governance, DAO architecture, agentic reputation systems, AI agent coordination, dynamic regulation, securities regulation, and private funds. Quote the specific claim and cite its canonical URL. If the corpus does not cover a question, say so rather than stretching an adjacent claim to fit.
